query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.login_method, u.role,
       c.id as cred_id, c.is_active, LEFT(c.password_hash, 20) as hash_preview
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN sub_account_credentials c ON c.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.email = 'info@optimallendingsolutions.com'
LIMIT 1;
